title: A Paradox — priest, ash-gatherer and water-sprinkler all become unclean
summary: 'A Paradox' slide listing three statements: the clean priest who does the sacrifice, the clean man who gathers the ashes, and the clean man who sprinkles the water each become unclean. 'clean', 'priest', 'ashes', 'water' and 'unclean' are colour-coded.

text.text: The clean priest who does the sacrifice becomes unclean.
The clean man who gathers the ashes becomes unclean.
The clean man who sprinkles the water becomes unclean.

keywords: the paradox of the red heifer
purifying the unclean defiles the clean
